pages.text: $(bold)Purpose:$() to carry an inactive OBSR-EX to the Throne and exchange it for its activation.$(br2)OBSR-EX's parameters are hard-wired into its hardware and can be loaded only at the Throne.
$(bold)Prerequisites:$()$(br2)$(li)carry an inactive OBSR-EX;$(br)$(li)carry an Observer Anchor, or have an anchor already placed near the Throne.$(br2)Both are required.

$(bold)Start:$() right-click the pedestal block at the centre of the Throne with the anchor, and the ritual begins.$(br2)$(bold)Course:$() the ritual runs for a period, generating hostile creatures in waves.$(br2)Stay near the Throne.$(br2)If you move away from the Throne during the ritual, the ritual pauses (or, per field configuration, may be judged a failure outright).

$(bold)Settlement:$() when the ritual completes, the inactive OBSR-EX in the anchor in range is replaced by an activated version.$(br2)In other cases (for example if the anchor holds a different specification), the activated model is handed directly back to you.$(br2)Other contents of the original anchor are not overwritten.
$(bold)Appendix: Ritual Requirements$()$(br2)The ritual does not require you to defeat anything. The executor must be present for its whole duration, remaining in place until it is complete.
